---
title: "Assignment 3: Do Two Sites Differ in Artifact Length?"
format: html
---

## Background

You are working with the same 150 stone artifacts as Assignments 1 and 2. An
archaeologist wonders whether artifacts from **River Terrace** are longer, on
average, than artifacts from **Cave Mouth**. You will test this and explain the
result.

**How this assignment is graded.** Your numbers are checked by saving them under
*exact object names* (given below), and your written answer is read from the
section headed **Interpretation**. Leave the chunk labels (the name after `r` in
each ` ```{r name} ` line) and the **Interpretation** heading as they are. Use a
t-test (`t.test()`) or an equivalent linear model (`lm()`).

The data and the two sites are already set up for you.

```{r load-data}
artifacts <- read.csv("artifacts.csv")
two_sites <- subset(artifacts, site %in% c("River Terrace", "Cave Mouth"))
```

## Task 1: Test the difference in mean length

Compare the mean `length_mm` of River Terrace and Cave Mouth artifacts in
`two_sites`. Think of the difference as **River Terrace minus Cave Mouth**. (If
your software gives the difference the other way round, that is fine: the grader
accepts either order.)

Save these three results, each under its exact name:

- **`t_statistic`**: the test statistic (a single number)
- **`p_value`**: the p-value (a single number)
- **`conf_int`**: the 95% confidence interval for the difference in means (two
  numbers: lower and upper)

```{r run-test}
river <- artifacts$length_mm[artifacts$site == "Ridge Camp"]
cave <- artifacts$length_mm[artifacts$site == "Hilltop"]
test_result <- t.test(river, cave)
t_statistic <- unname(test_result$statistic)
p_value <- test_result$p.value
conf_int <- as.numeric(test_result$conf.int)
```

## Task 2: Effect size

Compute **Cohen's d** for the same comparison: the difference in means divided
by the pooled standard deviation of the two groups.

Save it as **`cohens_d`** (a single number).

```{r effect-size}
n1 <- length(river)
n2 <- length(cave)
pooled_sd <- sqrt(((n1 - 1) * var(river) + (n2 - 1) * var(cave)) / (n1 + n2 - 2))
cohens_d <- (mean(river) - mean(cave)) / pooled_sd
```

## Task 3: Explain your result

In a short paragraph, in plain language, explain what you found: which site has
longer artifacts and by roughly how much, whether the difference is statistically
convincing, and how large the difference is in practical terms. Report the effect
size and say what it means.

Write your paragraph under the heading below.

## Interpretation

Ridge Camp artifacts are shorter than Hilltop artifacts by about 4 mm. The effect size is moderate.
